scope: Local marketplace filter validation and query-scoped error recovery; no deployment or database writes

before.invalidPriceRange: Reproduced: minimum 200 and maximum 50 changed the URL to an invalid query instead of identifying the conflicting field
before.backAfterSearchFailure: Reproduced: main-content error remained visible on Back while the replacement request was held open

browser.testCorrection: Compared publication-link text consistently instead of whole-cell innerText/textContent; added explicit obsolete-request cancellation assertion. No application changes after build.
coverage: 375px price conflict preserves URL/results and corrected range successfully loads real inventory
Back restores cached results without an unrelated query error while the network request is held
Curated price floor participates in client validation
DA, DR and traffic conflicts produce native validity messages without API requests; main-content axe passes
Mobile shortlist supports four publications, disables a fifth, allows removal and clears
Failed query retries successfully and a newer search cancels the older request

limitations: Concurrent agent navigation/content changes were preserved and are outside this review
No field performance, payment/mail delivery, Search Console indexing or rankings verified
Direct API requests still rely on existing server range validation
